label: private customer RFP and contract corpus (208 documents, 105 cases)
notes: Cases drafted by mistral, reviewed and corrected by an AI assistant (claude), approved by the maintainer; not human-verified case by case.
Judge agreement was measured against an AI assistant's grades, not a human's. Human calibration (ROADMAP P2-3) remains open.

Judge v1 is lenient against those grades: mean bias +0.21 on correct, +0.16 on faithful (n=14/19). answer_correct and faithfulness are overstated; use them to detect regressions, not as absolute quality.
Judge v2 (every specific checked) scored bias +0.04 correct / -0.26 faithful with 6 of 105 verdicts unparseable; kept in the script for comparison.
Retrieval metrics do not depend on the judge. Corpus has 64 file names duplicated across folders; source matching is by file name.
